integrity: The proof is self-contained from the stated definitions and Proposition 3.7 of the focal source; no computational or external certification claim is made.
scientific_limitations: Necessary conditions only; the existence of a demicontinuous anti-semicontinuous normed lattice remains open. Closely related arXiv:2609.06689 and arXiv:2604.02588 were compared through abstracts/indexed descriptions rather than complete text, leaving a residual equivalence risk.
title: Finite-stage order-adherence bounds for demicontinuous lattices
